prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed, photoreal macro portrait of the left half of an adult woman's face only, partially submerged underwater. Keep one brown eye in sharp focus near the upper-left area of the frame. Show visible pores, fine skin texture, detailed eyelashes, wet lips, natural freckles, suspended droplets, floating air bubbles, and subtle water movement. Use cinematic underwater lighting with light rays, dynamic caustic reflections, crisp highlights on wet skin and the water surface, soft natural underwater shadows, and realistic subsurface scattering. Use a macro lens with extremely shallow depth of field, physically accurate refraction, immersive dreamlike atmosphere, and portrait 3:4 framing.
